clue.text: He wants the beer cold

definitions.note: a male pronoun standing for a man's first name

parts.note: ale is a kind of beer
C is the standard abbreviation for cold on taps

explanation.surface: A drinker insists his pint be served chilled.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is just 'He': any man's name will do, and this one is a common short form of Alexander.
explanation.definitionFit: A man's forename can stand in for the pronoun referring to some particular fellow.

clue.text: A little paragraph on a south American city

definitions.meaning: a shortened form of the word paragraph
the old name of Belém, a port city at the mouth of the Amazon in Brazil

explanation.surface: A short passage of text written about a city in South America.
explanation.definitionFit: Editors abbreviate the word for a passage of prose, and Belém in Brazil was long known by this name.

clue.text: The outcome of a fearful upheaval

definitions.text: The outcome of a fearful upheaval

parts.words: The outcome of a fearful upheaval
parts.note: the upheaval is read as a volcanic eruption, and its outcome is the molten rock that pours out

explanation.surface: A grim consequence of some dreadful social or political turmoil.
explanation.definitionFit: Molten rock is what a volcano throws out when it erupts, a truly fearful upheaval of the earth.

clue.text: Dignified holy man at cathedral site

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for saint
Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire, England

explanation.surface: A solemn saintly figure standing at a cathedral.
explanation.walkthrough: ELY is a small English city famous for its cathedral.
explanation.definitionFit: A dignified bearing is grand and majestic, the sense of a stately procession.

clue.text: Stealing away when the child's asleep?

parts.note: a kid is a child, with the 's read as 'is'
napping means having a short sleep

explanation.surface: A question about abducting a youngster while it slumbers.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'child's asleep' as 'kid is napping' to split the word into its two halves.
explanation.definitionFit: Abduction is the carrying off of a person by force, stealing them away.

clue.text: Appeals with an attempt to make a joke of it

parts.note: pleas are earnest appeals or requests
a try is an attempt

explanation.surface: Someone pleads and tries to laugh the matter off.
explanation.definitionFit: A light, humorous remark made in conversation is a jest of this kind.

clue.text: The standard detectives adhere to

parts.note: the Yard is Scotland Yard, London's police detective headquarters
to stick is to adhere

explanation.surface: Police officers keeping to the rule book's norm.
explanation.walkthrough: Scotland Yard is the London Metropolitan Police headquarters, so 'detectives' gives YARD.
explanation.definitionFit: A measure or benchmark against which things are judged.

clue.text: Hide second family

parts.note: kin are one's family or relations

explanation.surface: A command to conceal a relative from a later marriage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hide' looks like a verb but is the noun: an animal's pelt.
explanation.definitionFit: An animal's pelt or outer covering is its hide.

clue.text: Pop into this — get exotic food

indicators.note: the father is placed within the rearranged letters
foreign and unusual, so the letters of this and get are reworked

parts.note: pa is a familiar word for father, like pop

explanation.surface: An invitation to drop in and try some foreign dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pop' looks like a verb, as in pop into a shop, but it is the father. 'exotic' rearranges the two words into SGHETTI; 'into' puts the father inside after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Long thin strands of Italian pasta are a staple dish.

clue.text: A letter or card

definitions.meaning: a written symbol such as a letter of the alphabet
a card is an eccentric or amusing person

explanation.surface: Choosing between writing someone a note or sending a greeting card.
explanation.definitionFit: A single written symbol is called this, and so is an odd, colourful individual or 'card'.

clue.text: Perch made of cane

definitions.meaning: an old measure of length, five and a half yards

explanation.surface: A bird's perch fashioned out of cane.
explanation.definitionFit: An old unit of length equal to a perch or pole, and also a straight stick like a cane.

clue.text: She's a nut — potty!

definitions.note: the 's is read as 'is', the clue saying she is the answer

indicators.note: potty means crazy, so the letters of a nut are jumbled

explanation.surface: A remark that some woman is completely crazy.
explanation.definitionFit: A female relative, a parent's sister, is one example of a 'she'.

clue.text: Shadow boxer?

definitions.meaning: to shadow is to follow someone closely
a boxer is a breed of hound, hence the question mark

explanation.surface: A fighter who practises by sparring with his own shadow.
explanation.definitionFit: To trail someone closely is to tail them, and a boxer is one breed of canine.

clue.text: Someone exercises the animals

parts.note: a man is someone, a person
drills are training exercises

explanation.surface: A person putting the creatures through their training.
explanation.definitionFit: Large West African baboons with brightly coloured faces are these creatures.

clue.text: Run a unit surrounded by friends in the main

indicators.note: the run and unit are placed between the two friends

parts.note: a mate and an ally are both friends
R is the cricket abbreviation for run
I is the Roman numeral one, a single unit

explanation.surface: Running a group while surrounded by friends at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the main' is an old phrase for the open sea, but 'in the main' means mostly. 'surrounded by' places the run and the unit between the two friends.
explanation.definitionFit: Substantially, in essence or for the most part.

clue.text: Any old sweater just will not do in the USA

definitions.text: Any old sweater just will not do in the USA

parts.words: Any old sweater just will not do in the USA
parts.note: read as a demand for a brand-new pullover, but it names a state on America's east coast

explanation.surface: An American shopper insists on a fresh pullover, not some worn one.
explanation.definitionFit: A US state on the Atlantic coast, between New York and Pennsylvania, whose name splits as a fresh pullover.

clue.text: This rogue might appear honest

indicators.note: suggests the letters of this rogue could be rearranged into another form

explanation.surface: A scoundrel disguising himself as an upright person.
explanation.definitionFit: Morally upright and virtuous, as an honest person is.

clue.text: A novelist's ambition

definitions.meaning: Anthony ..., author of The Prisoner of Zenda

explanation.surface: What a writer longs to achieve.
explanation.definitionFit: Anthony Hope wrote The Prisoner of Zenda, and an ambition is an aspiration or wish.

clue.text: Room to put in directions and time

indicators.note: the word to is placed inside the two compass points

parts.note: S and W are the compass points south and west
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: Space for including instructions and timing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put in' places TO between S and W, giving STOW.
explanation.definitionFit: Space available for storing cargo or belongings.

clue.text: Getting swine to follow a queue

parts.note: a pig is a swine
to tail is to follow

explanation.surface: Pigs being made to line up one behind another.
explanation.walkthrough: A queue here is an old word for a plait of hair hanging at the back, not a line of people.
explanation.definitionFit: A plait of hair hanging down the back, once called a queue.

clue.text: Duck trouble after drink!

indicators.note: the trouble is placed following the drink

parts.note: a pint is a drink of beer
to ail is to trouble

explanation.surface: Someone ducks the consequences of a drinking session.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-tailed dabbling waterbird is one species of this bird.

clue.text: Liberal bringing a charge about the right

indicators.note: the charge goes around the right

parts.note: a fee is a charge
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: A Liberal politician charges someone on the right wing.
explanation.definitionFit: Generous and unrestricted, as a liberal helping is lavish and unstinting.

clue.text: Instant scintillation

definitions.meaning: a moment, as in 'in the ... of an eye'
a sparkling or glittering of light

explanation.surface: A sudden flash of sparkle.
explanation.definitionFit: A very brief moment, and also the glittering of a star.

clue.text: Some people will await an order

indicators.note: only some of the letters of these words are taken

explanation.surface: Certain people wait for a command to be given.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' picks a run of letters across 'will await'.
explanation.definitionFit: A rule or decree laid down by authority.

clue.text: Leaders of rebellious uprisings eventually show regret

indicators.note: the opening letter of each of these three words is taken

explanation.surface: Heads of revolts eventually come to feel sorry.
explanation.definitionFit: To be sorry about something, to repent of it.

clue.text: Criticises kitchen equipment

explanation.surface: Someone finds fault with cookware.
explanation.definitionFit: Slates harshly, as a critic does, and also cooking vessels.

clue.text: When at one constituents may be weakening

indicators.note: the letters of when and at one are the ingredients to rearrange

explanation.surface: When united, voters may see their strength decline.
explanation.definitionFit: Declining or diminishing, like the moon after full.

clue.text: Formerly it could mean death

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife

explanation.surface: A thing from the past could mean dying.
explanation.definitionFit: A departure from life, as an actor makes an exit from the stage.

clue.text: The Spanish scholar brought up to be proficient

indicators.note: in a down clue, bringing up reads the letters from bottom to top

parts.note: el is Spanish for the
a BA is a Bachelor of Arts

explanation.surface: A Spanish academic raised to be skilful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought up' turns ELBA round into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Skilful, competent, having the capacity to do something well.

clue.text: Tea's made differently in the Orient

indicators.note: the letters of the word tea's are put together in another order

explanation.surface: Tea is brewed in a different way in Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: The countries of Asia are known as the Orient.

clue.text: Many bet the earth!

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a large number
to lay is to bet

explanation.surface: Lots of people wager everything they have.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bet the earth' suggests staking everything, but the earth here is soil.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy, sticky soil is a kind of earth.

clue.text: Not at all lively without fire-water

parts.note: fire-water is strong spirit
less means lacking, as in hopeless

explanation.surface: A dull party without any hard liquor.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking vigour or energy, listless and dull.
